user.title: Set up Clap Sensor (USB Microphone)
user.description: Select which entity should be toggled directly on 2x or 3x clap (works out-of-the-box without a separate automation!).

data.target_entity_id: Action on 2x Clap (Toggle entity, e.g. Light/Switch)
data.input_device: Audio input device ('auto' detects USB webcam automatically)
data.snr_threshold_db: Minimum SNR above background/fan noise in dB
data.min_high_freq_ratio: Min. high-frequency ratio 1–4.8 kHz (filters low thuds)
